summary: Backend-only testing of updated AI resource endpoints (task_resources, daily_item_resources) per review request. Verified fresh LLM generation, caching behavior, response shape/field completeness, Polish language output, valid JSON (no markdown), and expanded content length. Also sanity-checked register/login, /api/roadmap/custom, and /api/careers/{career_id}.
critical_code_review_comments: task_resources and daily_item_resources prompts/logic reviewed - the new isolation instruction and expanded length limits match the review request exactly (task_resources: overview 2-3 sentences/35 words, steps 4-6/14 words, free_tips 3-5/14 words, resources desc max 12 words, 5-8 resources; daily_item_resources: overview 1-2/25 words, steps 4-6/14 words, free_tips 2-4/12 words, 4-6 resources). No functional regressions found.
Caching logic unchanged and verified working correctly (cached calls return in <0.2s, identical payload) - confirmed not a bug per instructions.

success_rate.backend: 100% (4/4 executed tests passed; 1 skipped - no simple /api/careers list endpoint to source a catalog career_id, this is expected since custom-goal careers aren't in the catalog)

seed_data_creation: Created several TEST_*/test_* prefixed throwaway users via /api/auth/register and associated custom roadmaps/daily plans during testing; not cleaned up (read-only verification, low-risk test data).
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_resources_endpoints.py covers: register/login sanity, /api/roadmap/custom -> poll /api/roadmap until ready -> GET task resources (fresh gen, validates field shape, resource count 5-8, overview word-count qualitative check) -> GET again to confirm caching (identical payload, <5s). Daily-plan class attempts to auto-generate a plan item with milestone_task_id=null via LLM, which is probabilistic (skipped twice in pytest-xdist runs because the LLM didn't produce such an item for that session) - I validated this path manually instead by minting a JWT for an existing DB user/item (found via direct mongo query) that had milestone_task_id=null, and confirmed: HTTP 200, 6 resources, detailed Polish overview/steps/free_tips, proper caching on second call (0.157s). If a future agent wants this automated reliably in pytest, consider either running daily-plan settings across multiple seeded users until a null-task item appears, or directly inserting a test item into the roadmaps collection before calling the resources endpoint (test-only data setup, not touching business logic).
rca_of_issue: No bugs found. All verification points from the review request passed: (1) fresh task_resources call returns 200 with overview/steps/free_tips/specializations/time_estimate/resources (5-8 items, each with type/platform/title/description/query/url), content noticeably longer than old terse limits; (2) repeat call returns cached, byte-identical response near-instantly; (3) daily_item_resources for a non-milestone item returns 200 with 4-6 resources and detailed Polish overview/steps; (4) all responses valid JSON, Polish language, no markdown wrapping; (5) no 500/502 errors observed in backend logs during testing; (6) /api/roadmap/custom, register/login, and /api/careers/{id} (graceful 404 for unknown/custom ids) all work as before - no regressions.
